newsitem.title: USA: Dresser unit to get $102 mln asset sale.
newsitem.headline: Dresser unit to get $102 mln asset sale.

text.p: Dresser Industries Inc said its Sub Sea International unit has signed a definitive agreement to sell certain assets to Global Industries Ltd for $102 million in cash.

Dresser said major assets in the sale are three construction barges, liftboats and one dive support vessel based in the U.S. four support vessels based in the Middle East and support vessels and related equipment based in the Far East and Asia-Pacific.
It said that all of Sub Sea's Gulf of Mexico business related to remotely operated vehicles (ROVs) and engineering and activities in Europe and Brazil are excluded from the sale.
It said closing of the transaction is subject to regulatory approval and other customary conditions, including requisite waiting periods.
It said that the U.S. Department of Justice's antitrust unit has requested for additional information and both Sub Sea and Global expect to substantially comply before the end of June.
It said it expects the transaction to close during the second quarter of Global Industries' current fiscal 1998, which ends in September.
